Call your healthcare provider or Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222 or go to the nearest hospital emergency room right away. Advice is also available online at poisonhelp.org. WEGOVY Injection - Read the Instructions for Use that comes with WEGOVY. - Your healthcare provider should tell you which WEGOVY product you will be using (for example – single-dose pen or syringe, single-patient-use pen, or tablets). Before you use WEGOVY injection for the first time, your healthcare provider should show you how to use it. Once you have been trained, you may inject WEGOVY yourself if your healthcare provider determines that you are able to do so safely. If you are visually impaired, the WEGOVY FlexTouch pen is not recommended for self-injection. - If you are prescribed a different WEGOVY product at any point, make sure you receive new training for the new product and read the Instructions for Use that come with it. - WEGOVY is injected under the skin (subcutaneously) of your stomach (abdomen), thigh, or upper arm. Do not inject WEGOVY into a muscle (intramuscularly) or vein (intravenously). - Change (rotate) your injection site with each injection. Do not use the same site for each injection. - Use WEGOVY 1 time each week, on the same day each week, at any time of the day. - If you need to change the day of the week, you may do so as long as your last dose of WEGOVY was given 2 or more days before. - If you miss a dose of WEGOVY and the next scheduled dose is more than 2 days away (48 hours), take the missed dose as soon as possible. If you miss a dose of WEGOVY and the next scheduled dose is less than 2 days away (48 hours), do not administer the dose. Take your next dose on the regularly scheduled day. - If you miss doses of WEGOVY for 2 or more consecutive weeks, contact your healthcare provider to talk about how to restart your treatment. - You can take WEGOVY with or without food. WEGOVY Tablets - Take 1 WEGOVY tablet by mouth on an empty stomach in the morning with water (no more than 4 ounces). Do not take WEGOVY tablets with any other liquids besides water. - Do not split, crush, chew or dissolve WEGOVY tablets. Swallow WEGOVY tablets whole. - Do not take more than 1 WEGOVY tablet each day. - After 30 minutes, you can eat, drink, or take other oral medicines. - If you miss a dose of WEGOVY, skip the missed dose and go back to your regular schedule for the next dose.

text: How should I store WEGOVY? WEGOVY injection - Do not store WEGOVY in the freezer or directly beside the refrigerator cooling element. - Do not freeze WEGOVY and do not use WEGOVY if it has been frozen. - WEGOVY single-dose pen and single-dose syringe: - Store in the refrigerator between 36°F to 46°F (2°C to 8°C). - If needed, before removing the pen or syringe cap, WEGOVY single-dose pen and single-dose syringe can be stored from 46°F to 86°F (8°C to 30°C) in the original carton for up to 28 days. - Keep WEGOVY single-dose pen and syringe in the original carton to protect it from light. - Throw away the WEGOVY single-dose pen or syringe if it has been frozen, has been exposed to light or temperatures above 86°F (30°C), has been out of the refrigerator for 28 days or longer, or after use. - WEGOVY FlexTouch single-patient-use pen: - Store in the refrigerator between 36°F to 46°F (2°C to 8°C). - After first use, store WEGOVY FlexTouch pen between 59°F to 86°F (15°C to 30°C) or in the refrigerator between 36°F to 46°F (2°C to 8°C) for up to 56 days. - Protect WEGOVY FlexTouch pen from excessive heat and light. - Keep the pen cap on when not in use. - Always remove and safely discard the needle after each injection. - Store WEGOVY FlexTouch pen without an injection needle attached. - Always use a new needle for each injection. - Throw away if the WEGOVY FlexTouch pen if it has been frozen, has been exposed to light or temperatures above 86°F (30°C), or has been out of the refrigerator for 56 days or longer. WEGOVY tablets - Store WEGOVY tablets at room temperature between 68°F to 77°F (20°C to 25°C). - Store tablets in the original closed WEGOVY bottle until you are ready to take one. Do not store in any other container. - Store in a dry place away from moisture. Keep WEGOVY and all medicines out of the reach of children.
